- Backups/snapshots: backups are retained for 90 days by default; irreversible purging of snapshot copies can take up to an additional 30 days due to cross-region replication and garbage-collection windows.

Hi Samir / Marissa — thanks, happy to clarify. Answers below correspond to the numbered items in Samir’s note.

1) Backups & replicated snapshots
- Default: snapshots/backups are retained 90 days. This includes cross-region replicated snapshots. Because of replication and GC/retention windows, fully irreversible purging (i.e., removing all snapshot copies across regions) can take up to an additional 30 days after a deletion request is triggered.
- Contractual option: we can contractually shorten the snapshot purge window to 30 days post-request for an additional operational fee and with limited region scope (we’ll outline specifics in the SLA table).
- Encryption: all backups are encrypted at rest using customer-managed keys (KMS) or Redwood-managed keys; cross-region copies remain encrypted.

2) GDPR DSARs / Deletion SLA
- Standard: we measure deletion SLA from the point when the request is validated and accepted (we require basic verification to ensure the requestor is authorized) — default turnaround is 30 days.
- Legal/contract: we can include explicit 30-day contract language in the DPA. For tighter timelines (e.g., 7–14 days) we typically require an addendum and operational runbook.

3) Logs / Audit Trails
- Audit logs: stored separately from customer payload data; default retention 90 days.
- Anonymization/redaction: we can support redaction or aggregation of logs on request; full deletion of log entries that are tied to historical system events may require coordination and is usually handled on a case-by-case basis.
- Optional longer retention: up to 365 days available as a managed option for customers who need long-term auditability.

Other items
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report; we can provide a redacted version under NDA.
- HIPAA: we sign a BAA; controls mapping can be provided on request.
- Vendor questionnaire: preferred delivery is a Word/PDF we fill and return. We maintain a vendor-questionnaire template if that speeds things up (link below).

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-redacted.pdf (redacted report, available on NDA), DPA-v3.pdf (same as Marissa’s attachment).

Link to our vendor questionnaire template: https://forms.redwood.ai/vendor-questionnaire

If helpful I can also put a short write-up into the Retention-SLA table to make the backup purge windows explicit for your legal team.
